verdict.rationale: GrowthBook's rules docs say feature rules can be scoped, ramped, and scheduled, and a rule's release plan can ramp up automatically over time. Pricing lists 'Ramp schedules' as an Enterprise feature, so scheduled releases are a first-party capability. However, the evidence only names scheduling and never shows a rule set to activate at a specific future date and time. A gradual ramp is not the same as a one-off timed change, and the deploy-script toggle endpoint is user-side automation, so neither is credited. Missing for 10: documented detail on setting a specific future date/time for a flag or rule change, scheduling via API, behaviour outside Enterprise plans, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can schedule flag changes and releases to happen at a specific future time
